description: Fewer Mouse Picks When Still: 3 minutes with the camera and the mouse still (the game re-picks every other frame), then 12 left clicks on empty ground 1.5 s apart (Esc after each; the click path holds each for a fresh pick), then a far camera pan. Developer build. Pass: on logs skipped picks with nothing changed while still and capped picks during the pan and clicks held for a new pick with 0 timed out, off logs none; A/B metric: frame time p50/p99 of the measured pan, and the [ExtraHooks] GetRenderTargetData line for TS3W.exe+0x2DFF4A.

expect: \[PickReadback\] Last \d+ s: \d+ picks, [1-9]\d* skipped with nothing changed
\[PickReadback\] Last \d+ s: \d+ picks, \d+ skipped with nothing changed, [1-9]\d* skipped while the camera moved
